lines: [Verse 1 – Intimate low baritone, nearly spoken; restrained 6/8 pulse]
We started with a borrowed hammer,
half a plan and no good sense,
building things we couldn’t name yet.
some grew stronger in the flame.
[Pre-Chorus – Floor toms and Hammond organ slowly emerge]
Now the hammers hang in silence,
and the dust lies on the wire—
[Chorus – Full roots-rock band enters; broad, powerful, but still holding something back]
and the books still carry heat.
[Verse 2 – Return to a leaner groove; resonator answers the vocal]
There are fingerprints on every page,
coffee rings and drops of rain,
We mistook a few maps for the country,
then we learned to read the mountain
where the crooked roads would rhyme.
[Pre-Chorus – Greater tension, low brass rising underneath]
We never found the final word,
just better questions by the score—
and every time we reached the ending,
[Chorus – Heavier drums, wider guitars, stronger vocal grit]
and the books still carry heat.
[Bridge – Half-time feel; dark organ and low brass; vocal exposed, deliberate, and defiant]
Let the scholars keep their certainty,
let the prophets sell their signs.
We have stood beneath enough strange stars
We don’t kneel before the compass.
We don’t curse it when it spins.
We hold it loosely in our hands
and ask where north has been.
[Verse 3 – Pull back sharply; intimate storytelling over acoustic guitar and bowed bass]
through the things we left behind—
all the blunt and broken instruments,
all the blueprints of the mind.
They may never know the laughter
or the nights we nearly quit,
but they’ll feel warmth between the pages
when they lay their hands on it.
[Final Chorus – Massive live drums, roaring organ, resonator, electric guitar, and low brass; fierce, expansive release]
It passed from hand to open hand,
[Outro – Instruments fall away to acoustic guitar and distant resonator; final lines warm, quiet, and unresolved]
So leave the door unlocked tonight.
Leave one lamp against the dark.
